description: This file defines the Metric class within the Goteo application, modeling a database entity that represents a metric with functionality to retrieve, save, and validate metric data.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: Represents a metric database entity with methods for retrieving, saving, and validating metrics.

methods.name: getMetric
methods.description: Retrieves a Metric object by its metric string; creates and saves a new object if it does not exist.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current Metric object to the database after validation, handling errors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Metric object, ensuring the metric string is not empty.
